 Gigi Hadid and Bradley Cooper may have stepped out on separate outings, but they each rocked a similar looking ring on that finger as they continue to fuel marriage rumors .
 The 31-year-old supermodel and 51-year-old Oscar nominee were seen leaving his New York City home at different times on Wednesday.
 The power couple first sparked marriage rumors last summer when they were photographed wearing matching gold bands on their left ring fingers. 
 Hadid looked casually cool in a long brown coat along with light brown leather boots.
 She accessorized with a striped beanie, scarf, dangling gold earrings and designer shades while out in the Big Apple along with the aforementioned jewelry on the marriage finger.
 Cooper donned a navy blue long-sleeved button down with L’Art de L’Automobile on the chest along with blue jeans  and white On Sneakers.

 I'm Andrew Court, LA Showbiz Editor and celebrity connoisseur. 
 I've spent the past decade chasing down celebrity scoops and scandals, and now I'm bringing the best of them straight to your inbox.

 He also sported a light blue beanie, sunglasses and Apple Air Pods Max headphones but it was the gold band on that particular finger that drew the eye. 
 Last month, Hadid showed off her much-talked about ring while getting ready backstage at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026. 
 The blonde beauty flashed a smile while getting her makeup done and chatting with interviewers, with the ring on her finger adding fuel to ongoing rumors she secretly tied the knot with the talented thespian.
 And the latest outing comes three months after the couple initially sparked marriage buzz after being photographed with their matching jewelry during another trip to Paris in August.
 At the time, Page Six reported Cooper and Hadid's new bands were part of a collection made by French jeweler Boucheron.
 The supermodel was wearing the $6,450 Quarter Radiant Edition Wedding Band featuring 'yellow gold grosgrain' and 'accented by a delicate line of diamonds.'
 The site also claimed Cooper was wearing the $2,120 Godron Pink Gold Wedding Band.
 Cooper was married to actress Jennifer Esposito from December 2006 until she filed for divorce in May 2007 after only four months .
 The power couple first sparked marriage rumors last summer when they were photographed wearing matching gold bands on their left ring fingers
 Last month, Hadid showed off her much-talked about ring while getting ready backstage at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026 
 He has a daughter, Lea De Seine, nine, with Russian-born model Irina Shayk, and even though they broke off their relationship after four years , they maintain an amicable co-parenting situation.
 Hadid has six-year-old daughter Khai with former partner Zayn Malik. 
 She has been dating the Hangover actor for three years and recently shared in a September 2026 cover story for  Vogue  she loves how 'honest' they can be with one another.
 'What's beautiful about my current relationship, and so different from what I've experienced before, is the ability to be deeply honest. To say what we think, when we think it,' she told the publication. 
 The two have been going strong since meeting at a birthday party for a mutual friend's child (Above, in New York in September 2025)
 Hadid recently told Vogue she loves how 'honest' they can be with one another
 Cooper and Hadid were among the guests to attend Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's July 4 nuptials at New York City's Madison Square Garden. Above, the couple are pictured leaving the wedding venue
 'But if it's impossible, it probably means it's not the right person,' she added.
 Hadid, who attended Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding at New York City's Madison Square Garden with Cooper, has a better appreciation of Paris and she could even see herself living in France one day, thanks in part to her beau.
 'For a long time, Paris was a city of work. I'd land there, rush to a hotel where twenty photographers were waiting for me — no walking around was possible — then I'd be in a car to a windowless studio,' she said.
 'But recently, thanks to my boyfriend who loves France and speaks French, I've discovered a completely different Paris that I adore. So, at some point, why not settle there, yes.'
